- Under the Crisafulli Government's Energy Roadmap, Powerlink's Connections Guarantee commits to enquiry responses within 30 business days (40 for dedicated connection assets) per the NER.
- It also commits to assessing 75% of performance-standard packages within 30 business days, negotiated access standard decisions within 30 business days of complete information, and 90% on-time delivery under executed agreements, explicitly covering transmission-connected loads.
- Powerlink's 2025 TAPR flags data centres as a major driver of south-east Queensland demand.
steps.detail_zh:
约50–100 MW以上、或邻近110/132/275 kV变电站的负荷，依NER第5章直接接入Powerlink。
- Powerlink的Connection Application Guide涵盖咨询、申请、Connection and Access Agreement（C&AA）谈判、接入报价及调试；申请阶段“名义上需12–18个月”，视范围及是否接受标准商业条款而定，AEMO评估费转嫁客户。
- 依Crisafulli政府Energy Roadmap，Powerlink的Connections Guarantee承诺按NER在30个工作日内回复咨询（专用接入资产40日）。
- 还承诺75%的性能标准包在30个工作日内完成评估、协商接入标准在资料齐备后30个工作日内决定、已签协议项目90%按时交付，明确涵盖输电接入负荷。
- Powerlink 2025年TAPR把数据中心列为昆州东南部需求增长的主要驱动。
steps.authority: Powerlink Queensland (TNSP); AEMO (advisory matters)
steps.legal_basis: NER cl 5.3.2–5.3.7, Schedule 5.3; Powerlink Connections Guarantee (Queensland Energy Roadmap, policy commitment)
steps.typical_duration: Application stage 12–18 months; 2–3 years enquiry to energisation
steps.overlap_note_en: The Guarantee restates NER timeframes as state policy; performance standards for ≥30 MW inverter-based loads will follow the AEMC's ERC0394 final rule.
steps.overlap_note_zh: Connections Guarantee以州政策形式重申NER时限；30 MW及以上逆变器型负荷的性能标准将以AEMC ERC0394最终规则为准。

steps.title_en: Energex / Ergon large customer connection (NER Chapter 5A or 5) under the Large Customer Connection Manual
steps.title_zh: Energex/Ergon大客户配电接入
steps.detail_en:
Distribution-connected data centres (11–110 kV, typically up to ~60 MW) follow Energy Queensland's Large Customer Connection Manual (effective 5 January 2026).
- Chapter 5A pathway: the DNSP acknowledges an enquiry within 5 business days, may require pre-application services, and aims to issue a negotiated connection offer within 65 business days of a complete application, to be accepted within 20 business days.
- Chapter 5 pathway: preliminary response in 15 business days, detailed response in 30 business days, offer within four months.
- Connection assets and large-customer extensions are alternative control services charged user-pays up front, with capital contributions for standard control augmentation outside the planning horizon.
- Customers may design-construct-transfer connection assets or have the DNSP build-own-operate; financial security may be required.
- The manual contains no data-centre-specific provisions.
steps.detail_zh:
配网接入的数据中心（11–110 kV，一般不超过约60 MW）遵循Energy Queensland的Large Customer Connection Manual（2026年1月5日生效）。
- 第5A章路径：DNSP在5个工作日内确认咨询，可要求预申请服务，力争在完整申请后65个工作日内出具协商接入报价，客户须20个工作日内接受。
- 第5章路径：初步回复15个工作日、详细回复30个工作日、报价4个月内出具。
- 接入资产及大客户延伸线路属替代管制服务，用户预先付费；规划期以外的标准管制增容另收资本分摊。
- 客户可采用设计–建造–移交模式，或由DNSP建设–持有–运营；可能要求提供财务担保。
- 手册中没有针对数据中心的专门条款。
steps.authority: Energex / Ergon Energy (Energy Queensland); AER (connection policy)
steps.legal_basis: NER Chapter 5A Part D (negotiated connections) or Chapter 5; Energex/Ergon Connection Policies approved by AER; Large Customer Connection Manual (Jan 2026)
steps.typical_duration: Offer 65 business days (Ch 5A) or 4 months (Ch 5); total 9–18 months
steps.overlap_note_en: Pure NER process; Queensland adds no state overlay beyond the Energy Roadmap service commitments.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 纯NER程序；除Energy Roadmap的服务承诺外，昆州未叠加州级规则。

steps.title_en: Connection and Access Agreement, augmentation and cost allocation
steps.title_zh: C&AA接入协议、增容与成本分担
steps.detail_en:
Powerlink's Connection and Access Agreement (the NER cl 5.3.7 connection agreement) prices connection assets as negotiated or prescribed transmission services.
- Shared-network augmentation needed for a large load is assessed under the RIT-T (cl 5.16) and, if justified, recovered through Powerlink's regulated revenue from all Queensland customers.
- The pending Commonwealth cost-recovery rule changes and National Cabinet standards aim to shift that cost to the data centre.
- Queensland has not introduced NSW-style bonds or upgrade fees.
- Government-owned generators (CS Energy, Stanwell, CleanCo) and Powerlink are being positioned to offer firmed supply, consistent with the state's energy-agnostic stance.
steps.detail_zh:
Powerlink的Connection and Access Agreement（即NER cl 5.3.7接入协议）将接入资产按协商或规定输电服务定价。
- 大负荷所需的共享网络增容依RIT-T（cl 5.16）评估，通过测试的经Powerlink受监管收入由全体昆州用户分摊。
- 联邦待审成本回收规则修改及国家内阁标准的目标，是把这部分成本转由数据中心承担。
- 昆州未引入新州式的保证金或升级费。
- 国有发电商（CS Energy、Stanwell、CleanCo）及Powerlink正被定位为可靠电力供应方，与该州能源技术中立立场一致。
steps.authority: Powerlink / Energex / Ergon; AER
steps.legal_basis: NER cl 5.3.7, 5.16 RIT-T, 5.17 RIT-D; Chapter 6A Part D; Chapter 5A Part E
steps.typical_duration: 6–12 months to executed agreement
steps.overlap_note_en: Cost allocation is national; Queensland dissented from renewable-only sourcing but accepted the 'pay full network costs' national standard.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 成本分担属全国事项；昆州反对仅限可再生能源的供电要求，但接受了“全额支付网络成本”的全国标准。

steps.title_en: Retailer/FRMP, AEMO registration and energy sourcing (energy-agnostic firming)
steps.title_zh: 零售商/FRMP、AEMO注册与技术中立供电
steps.detail_en:
A retailer is appointed as FRMP or the operator registers as a Market Customer with AEMO; metering follows NER Chapter 7.
- Queensland argued at the July–August 2026 ECMC and National Cabinet meetings for a technology-agnostic approach.
- Under the agreed national framework Queensland data centres may satisfy the firming requirement with coal or gas-backed contracts, while still needing new-generation REGO certificates once the Commonwealth legislates.
- The Western Downs project cites nearby gas plants plus solar and wind.
- AEMO registration of large facilities is expected 24–36 months after ministerial endorsement.
steps.detail_zh:
指定零售商为FRMP，或由运营商向AEMO注册为Market Customer；计量遵循NER第7章。
- 昆州在2026年7–8月ECMC及国家内阁会议上力主技术中立。
- 在已达成的全国框架下，昆州数据中心可用煤电或燃气支撑的合约满足可靠容量要求，但联邦立法后仍须持有新建电源的REGO证书。
- Western Downs项目的供电方案提到附近燃气电厂加光伏、风电。
- 大型设施的AEMO注册预计在部长认可后24–36个月落地。
steps.authority: Retailer/FRMP; AEMO
steps.legal_basis: NER Chapter 2, Chapter 7; National Cabinet framework (26 Aug 2026)
steps.typical_duration: 3–12 months
steps.overlap_note_en: National process; Queensland's carve-out changes what counts as firm capacity, not the NER registration mechanics.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 全国程序；昆州的例外只改变可靠容量的认定口径，不改变NER注册机制。

steps.title_en: Construction, commissioning and energisation
steps.title_zh: 建设、调试与送电
steps.detail_en:
Building approvals are issued by a private certifier under the Building Act 1975; the Electrical Safety Act 2002 governs installation safety.
- Powerlink or the DNSP witnesses commissioning under the connection agreement (NER cl 5.7–5.8).
- The Connections Guarantee tracks on-time delivery.
- Energisation is usually staged against consented capacity, with ongoing compliance against DA conditions and the environmental authority.
steps.detail_zh:
建筑批准由私人审核员依Building Act 1975签发；Electrical Safety Act 2002规范安装安全。
- Powerlink或DNSP依接入协议见证调试（NER cl 5.7–5.8）。
- Connections Guarantee追踪按时交付情况。
- 送电通常按获批容量分阶段进行，并须持续遵守DA条件及环境授权。
steps.authority: Private certifier; Electrical Safety Office; Powerlink / Energex / Ergon
steps.legal_basis: Building Act 1975 (Qld); Electrical Safety Act 2002 (Qld); NER cl 5.7–5.8
steps.typical_duration: Construction 18–30 months; commissioning 2–6 months per stage
steps.overlap_note_en: Commissioning follows national NER/AEMO procedures; state adds building and electrical safety certification.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 调试遵循全国NER/AEMO程序；州层面增加建筑及电气安全认证。

recent_changes.summary_en: Queensland announced on 2 October 2026 that data centre development applications will be assessed by the State through SARA rather than by local councils, using the framework applied to renewable energy projects since July 2025, with a social impact assessment and a community benefit agreement required before lodgement and the amending regulation and size thresholds still to be published.
recent_changes.summary_zh: 昆州于2026年10月2日宣布，数据中心开发申请改由州级SARA评估而非地方议会，沿用2025年7月起适用于可再生能源项目的框架；申请前须完成社会影响评估并与议会签订社区利益协议，修订条例与适用门槛尚未公布。

recent_changes.summary_en: Zerra DC's 2.16 GW Western Downs Digital Park near Dalby (A$31.9 bn) lodged with Western Downs Regional Council, proposing direct Powerlink substation connection and a hybrid gas/renewable supply—the largest test of Queensland's council-DA pathway for hyperscale loads.
recent_changes.summary_zh: Energy Queensland的Large Customer Connection Manual于2026年1月5日生效，整合Energex/Ergon第5章及第5A章大负荷接入程序、时限与成本回收类别。

recent_changes.summary_en: Premier Crisafulli opposed renewable-only sourcing, secured an energy-agnostic firming approach at National Cabinet (26 Aug), and announced data centres will need a social impact assessment and community benefit agreement with councils before lodging a DA.
recent_changes.summary_zh: 州长Crisafulli反对仅限可再生能源供电，8月26日在国家内阁争取到能源技术中立的可靠容量方式，并宣布数据中心须在提交DA前完成社会影响评估并与议会签订社区利益协议。

recent_changes.summary_en: SDPWO (Critical Minerals) and Other Legislation Amendment Bill passed (26 Aug 2026) creating 'State strategic projects' but expressly excluding commercial and R&D data centres from that fast-track.
recent_changes.summary_zh: SDPWO (Critical Minerals) and Other Legislation Amendment Bill于2026年8月26日通过，新设“State strategic project”快速通道，但明确排除商业及研发数据中心。

recent_changes.summary_en: Energy Queensland's Large Customer Connection Manual took effect (5 Jan 2026), consolidating Energex/Ergon Chapter 5 and 5A processes, timeframes and cost-recovery categories for large loads.
recent_changes.summary_zh: Zerra DC向Western Downs Regional Council提交达尔比附近2.16 GW的Western Downs Digital Park申请（319亿澳元），拟直连Powerlink变电站并采用燃气/可再生混合供电，是昆州议会DA路径承接超大规模负荷的最大考验。

jurisdictions.market: WEM (Wholesale Electricity Market, South West Interconnected System) – not the NEM; NER does not apply
jurisdictions.key_bodies: Western Australian Planning Commission / Statutory Planning Committee, local governments, Development Assessment Panels, Department of Planning, Lands and Heritage, WA EPA / DWER, Western Power (network operator, SWIS), AEMO (WEM operator and system operator in WA), Economic Regulation Authority (ERA), Coordinator of Energy / Department of Energy and Economic Diversification (EPWA), Synergy and contestable retailers, Building and Energy (electrical safety), Horizon Power (regional)
jurisdictions.overview_en:
Western Australia sits outside the NEM, so its own market and network-access law, not the NER, governs large-load connections.
- The South West Interconnected System runs under the Electricity Industry Act 2004, the Wholesale Electricity Market Rules and the Electricity Networks Access Code 2004, with Western Power processing applications under its ERA-regulated Applications and Queuing Policy, Contributions Policy and Technical Rules.
- Large distribution loads (≥10 MVA) and transmission loads (typically 132/330 kV) go through Western Power's major customer connection process, refreshed June 2026.
- Supply comes from Synergy or a contestable retailer, which must hold Individual Reserve Capacity Requirements under the WEM's Reserve Capacity Mechanism, so a 100 MW data centre needs certified capacity locked in years ahead.
- Planning consent is granted by local government or a Development Assessment Panel under the Planning and Development Act 2005, or via the permanent Significant Development Pathway (Part 11B, from 1 March 2024, ≥$20m in Perth/Peel, WAPC Statutory Planning Committee, 120-day target).
- WA has no published data-centre-specific policy; a July 2026 EPWA issues paper on connections reform and Perth's subsea-cable/renewables advantages are the main state-level developments.
jurisdictions.overview_zh:
西澳不属于NEM，大负荷并网依州内自有市场及网络接入法律体系办理，而非NER。
- SWIS受《2004年电力工业法》、《批发电力市场规则》及《2004年电力网络接入守则》约束，Western Power依经ERA监管的《申请与排队政策》、《分摊政策》和《技术规则》处理接入申请。
- 大型配电负荷（≥10 MVA）及输电负荷（通常132/330 kV）均走Western Power的大客户接入程序，2026年6月已更新。
- 电力由Synergy或可竞争零售商供应，零售商须依WEM备用容量机制持有个体备用容量要求，故100 MW级数据中心须提前数年锁定经认证的容量。
- 规划许可依《2005年规划与发展法》由地方政府或开发评估委员会发放，或走永久性重大开发路径（第11B部分，2024年3月1日起，珀斯/皮尔地区2000万澳元以上，由WAPC法定规划委员会以120天为目标裁定）。
- 西澳没有专门的数据中心政策；2026年7月EPWA接入改革议题文件及珀斯的海缆和可再生能源优势是主要的州级动态。

steps.title_en: Site selection, zoning under local planning scheme and early Western Power capacity discussion
steps.title_zh: 选址、分区及Western Power早期沟通
steps.detail_en:
Data centre siting starts with confirming zoning permissibility and early network engagement before land is committed.
- Under the Planning and Development (Local Planning Schemes) Regulations 2015 model provisions, data centres are generally 'industry' or 'telecommunications infrastructure' uses, permitted ('P') or discretionary ('D') in industrial zones of the relevant local planning scheme.
- Some industrial estates (Kwinana, Kewdale, Malaga, Neerabup) are covered by structure plans or improvement schemes.
- SWIS capacity is concentrated around Perth's 132 kV ring and the north-south 330 kV backbone, so proponents should lodge an early enquiry through Western Power's MyWPProjects portal and review its quarterly Major Customer Connections Insights Report before committing to land.
- Native title and Aboriginal heritage due diligence under the Aboriginal Heritage Act 1972 (restored 2023) is also completed at this stage.
steps.detail_zh:
选址阶段须先核实分区可行性，并在落实土地前尽早与电网对接。
- 依《2015年规划与发展（地方规划方案）条例》示范条款，数据中心一般归为“工业”或“电信基础设施”用途，在相关地方规划方案的工业区中属允许（P）或酌情（D）用途。
- 部分工业区（Kwinana、Kewdale、Malaga、Neerabup）适用结构规划或改善方案。
- SWIS容量集中在珀斯132 kV环网及南北向330 kV主干，业主应在确定土地前通过Western Power的MyWPProjects门户提交早期咨询，并查阅其季度《大客户接入洞察报告》。
- 原住民土地权及依《1972年原住民遗产法》（2023年恢复）的遗产尽职调查亦在此阶段完成。
steps.authority: Local government; Department of Planning, Lands and Heritage; Western Power
steps.legal_basis: Planning and Development Act 2005 (WA); Planning and Development (Local Planning Schemes) Regulations 2015; Aboriginal Heritage Act 1972
steps.typical_duration: 2–6 months
steps.overlap_note_en: FIRB screening and Commonwealth data centre expectations apply; National Cabinet standards will overlay WA planning once legislated.
steps.overlap_note_zh: FIRB审查及联邦数据中心期望框架适用；国家内阁标准立法后将叠加于西澳规划审批之上。

steps.title_en: Development approval: local government / DAP, or Significant Development Pathway (Part 11B)
steps.title_zh: 开发批准：地方政府/DAP或第11B部分路径
steps.detail_en:
Development approval runs through either the standard council/DAP track or the state-level fast-track pathway.
- A development application is determined by local government, or by a Development Assessment Panel where estimated cost exceeds the DAP thresholds (mandatory above $10m in most areas, optional from $2m), within 60 or 90 days under the deemed provisions.
- Since 1 March 2024, the permanent Significant Development Pathway (Part 11B, Planning and Development Act) lets projects of at least $20m in Perth/Peel (or $5m elsewhere) be determined by the WAPC's Statutory Planning Committee, which can override local scheme requirements.
- The Committee targets a decision within 120 days, with a stop-the-clock mechanism; DPLH's guidance does not name data centres specifically, but they meet the cost test.
- Review of a refusal lies only to the State Administrative Tribunal, and only the applicant may apply.
steps.detail_zh:
开发批准可走标准的议会/DAP路径，或州级快速通道。
- 开发申请由地方政府裁定，或在预计成本超过DAP门槛时（多数地区1000万澳元以上强制、200万澳元起可选）由开发评估委员会裁定，依默示条款期限为60或90天。
- 自2024年3月1日起，永久性重大开发路径（《规划与发展法》第11B部分）允许珀斯/皮尔地区2000万澳元以上（其他地区500万澳元以上）的项目由WAPC法定规划委员会裁定，可凌驾地方方案要求。
- 该委员会以含暂停计时机制的120天为目标作出决定；DPLH指引未特别点名数据中心，但其符合成本测试。
- 对拒批的复审仅可向州行政法庭申请，且仅申请人有权提出。
steps.authority: Local government or Development Assessment Panel; WAPC Statutory Planning Committee (Part 11B)
steps.legal_basis: Planning and Development Act 2005 (WA) Part 11B (Significant Development Pathway), Part 17 (closed); Planning and Development (Development Assessment Panels) Regulations 2011; Planning and Development (Local Planning Schemes) Regulations 2015 Sch 2 deemed provisions
steps.typical_duration: DAP 90 days; Part 11B 120-day target; 6–12 months in practice
steps.overlap_note_en: EPBC referral, if triggered, is coordinated under the WA–Commonwealth bilateral assessment agreement; otherwise a purely state approval.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 如触发EPBC评估，依西澳–联邦双边评估协议协调办理；否则纯属州级审批。

steps.title_en: Environmental approvals: EPA referral (EP Act Part IV) and DWER works approval/licence (Part V)
steps.title_zh: 环境审批：EPA转介及DWER许可
steps.detail_en:
Environmental clearance covers EPA referral and DWER licensing for large backup generation.
- Proposals likely to significantly affect the environment may be referred to the WA EPA under s 38 of the Environmental Protection Act 1986; most metropolitan data centres are not formally assessed, but large greenfield campuses involving clearing or major water demand can be.
- Prescribed premises under Schedule 1 of the Environmental Protection Regulations 1987 (e.g. category 52, fuel-fired electricity generation above 10 MW) need a works approval and licence from DWER for large diesel/gas backup fleets.
- Water Corporation servicing agreements are required, and groundwater use needs a licence under the Rights in Water and Irrigation Act 1914.
steps.detail_zh:
环境审批涵盖EPA转介及DWER对大型备用发电的许可。
- 可能对环境产生重大影响的提案可依《1986年环境保护法》第38条转介西澳EPA；多数都市数据中心不作正式评估，但涉及清理或大量用水的大型新开发园区可能需要。
- 属于《1987年环境保护条例》附表1规定场所的（如类别52——超过10 MW的燃料发电）大型柴油/燃气备用机组需向DWER申领工程批准及许可。
- 须与水务公司签订服务协议，使用地下水的还需依《1914年水权与灌溉法》申领许可。
steps.authority: WA EPA; Department of Water and Environmental Regulation (DWER)
steps.legal_basis: Environmental Protection Act 1986 (WA) Part IV (s 38 referral) and Part V (works approvals, licences); Environmental Protection Regulations 1987 Sch 1
steps.typical_duration: Part V works approval 3–6 months; Part IV assessment 12–24 months if required
steps.overlap_note_en: WA's Part IV assessment is accredited under the EPBC bilateral agreement, so a single assessment can serve both levels.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 西澳第IV部分评估已获EPBC双边协议认可，单一评估即可同时满足两级要求。

steps.title_en: Western Power access application: enquiry, Applications and Queuing Policy, access offer (Electricity Networks Access Code 2004)
steps.title_zh: Western Power接入申请与报价
steps.detail_en:
Access proceeds through Western Power's major-customer process from enquiry to offer.
- The process applies to distribution loads of 10 MVA or more and to all transmission-connected loads: enquiry via MyWPProjects, a fee-based preliminary/feasibility study, a formal access application under Chapter 5 of the Electricity Networks Access Code 2004.
- The application is placed in a queue and processed under the ERA-approved Applications and Queuing Policy, with network studies run against the ERA-approved Technical Rules.
- An access offer follows, leading to an Electricity Transfer Access Contract (ETAC) and a Customer Access Contract.
- Western Power's Major Customer Connection Review produced an updated Major Customer Connection Process (June 2026) and quarterly Insights Reports; no published stage timeframes exist, but enquiry-to-offer for a transmission load runs 12–24 months in practice.
- The State's DER and connections reform issues paper (20 July 2026) also touches network capacity sharing.
steps.detail_zh:
接入按Western Power大客户程序从咨询走到报价。
- 该程序适用于10 MVA及以上配电负荷及所有输电接入负荷：通过MyWPProjects提交咨询、付费开展初步/可行性研究、依《2004年电力网络接入守则》第5章提交正式接入申请。
- 申请进入队列，依ERA批准的《申请与排队政策》处理，网络研究按ERA批准的《技术规则》进行。
- 随后发出接入报价，进而签订电力传输接入合同（ETAC）及客户接入合同。
- Western Power大客户接入审查形成了更新的《大客户接入程序》（2026年6月）及季度《洞察报告》；未公布各阶段时限，实践中输电负荷从咨询到报价需12–24个月。
- 州政府2026年7月20日的DER与接入改革议题文件也涉及网络容量共享。
steps.authority: Western Power (network operator); Economic Regulation Authority (Access Code, Technical Rules, Applications and Queuing Policy)
steps.legal_basis: Electricity Networks Access Code 2004 (WA) Chapter 5 (applications and queuing), Chapter 6 (contributions), Technical Rules (ss 12.1–12.3); Electricity Industry Act 2004 Part 8
steps.typical_duration: 12–24 months enquiry to access offer for transmission loads
steps.overlap_note_en: The NER does not apply; the Access Code is the WA equivalent of NER Chapter 5. Commonwealth data centre standards (registration, firm capacity) will need WEM-specific implementation.
steps.overlap_note_zh: NER不适用；《接入守则》是西澳版的NER第5章。联邦数据中心标准（注册、可靠容量）须在WEM中另行落实。

steps.title_en: Network augmentation and capital contributions (Contributions Policy, Chapter 6 of the Access Code)
steps.title_zh: 网络扩建与资本分摊
steps.detail_en:
Cost allocation is governed by the Access Code's contributions regime rather than a RIT-T-style test.
- Under Chapter 6 of the Access Code and Western Power's ERA-approved Contributions Policy, the applicant pays a capital contribution for connection assets and for shared-network augmentation whose cost exceeds the incremental revenue Western Power expects from the load over the regulatory period (the 'new facilities investment test', s 6.52).
- Western Power may offer non-standard or 'flexible' connections where the customer accepts curtailment; deposits or bank guarantees are commonly required.
- There is no RIT-T; major augmentations are instead justified through Western Power's Access Arrangement (AA6, 2027–2032, currently under ERA review) and the Whole of System Plan.
steps.detail_zh:
成本分担依《接入守则》分摊机制办理，而非RIT-T式测试。
- 依《接入守则》第6章及Western Power经ERA批准的《分摊政策》，申请人须为接入资产及成本超过Western Power预期在监管期内从该负荷获得的增量收入的共享网络扩建支付资本分摊（第6.52条“新设施投资测试”）。
- Western Power可在客户接受限电的情况下提供非标准或“灵活”接入，通常要求缴纳保证金或银行担保。
- 西澳没有RIT-T；重大扩建改为通过Western Power的《接入安排》（AA6，2027–2032年，目前由ERA审查中）及《全系统规划》论证。
steps.authority: Western Power; ERA
steps.legal_basis: Electricity Networks Access Code 2004 Chapter 6 (ss 6.40–6.60 contributions, new facilities investment test); Western Power Contributions Policy
steps.typical_duration: Determined with the access offer
steps.overlap_note_en: The Commonwealth's 'pay full network costs' standard largely mirrors existing WA practice, where contributions already fall on the causer.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 联邦“全额支付网络成本”标准与西澳现行做法基本一致，后者已由引起成本的一方承担分摊。

steps.title_en: WEM arrangements: retailer / Market Customer registration and Reserve Capacity
steps.title_zh: WEM安排：零售商注册与备用容量
steps.detail_en:
Market arrangements run through WEM registration and the Reserve Capacity Mechanism rather than the NEM.
- Electricity is bought from Synergy or a contestable retailer (customers above 50 MWh/yr are contestable), or the operator registers with AEMO as a Market Participant/Market Customer under the WEM Rules.
- Under the Reserve Capacity Mechanism, the serving retailer must hold Capacity Credits equal to its Individual Reserve Capacity Requirement, assigned two years ahead, so a 100+ MW step change must be flagged early to AEMO's WA forecasting team and the retailer, or the market risks a capacity shortfall and elevated Reserve Capacity Prices.
- Large loads may also register as Demand Side Programmes to earn capacity payments for curtailability.
- Data centres face no WA-specific registration obligation today; AEMO counts 15 operating WA data centres.
steps.detail_zh:
市场安排依WEM注册及备用容量机制办理，而非NEM。
- 电力从Synergy或可竞争零售商购买（年用电量超过50 MWh的客户可自由选择），或由运营商依WEM规则向AEMO注册为市场参与者/市场客户。
- 依备用容量机制，供电零售商须持有与其个体备用容量要求相等的容量信用，该要求提前两年分配，因此100 MW以上的负荷跃升须及早告知AEMO西澳预测团队及零售商，否则市场可能面临容量短缺及备用容量价格上升。
- 大负荷也可注册为需求侧计划，凭可削减性获得容量收益。
- 数据中心目前不面临任何西澳特有的注册义务；AEMO统计西澳有15个运营中的数据中心。
steps.authority: AEMO (WEM operator); ERA; Synergy / contestable retailers
steps.legal_basis: Wholesale Electricity Market Rules (WA) Chapter 2 (registration) and Chapter 4 (Reserve Capacity Mechanism, Individual Reserve Capacity Requirements); Electricity Industry Act 2004; Electricity Corporations Act 2005
steps.typical_duration: Retail contracting 3–9 months; capacity year cycle 2 years ahead
steps.overlap_note_en: The AEMC's advice applies to the NEM; implementing REGO/firm-capacity and registration standards in the WEM will require separate WA rule changes by the Coordinator of Energy.
steps.overlap_note_zh: AEMC的建议适用于NEM；在WEM中落实REGO/可靠容量及注册标准，须由能源协调官另行修改西澳规则。

steps.title_en: Metering, commissioning and energisation (Metering Code, Technical Rules, Building and Energy)
steps.title_zh: 计量、调试与送电
steps.detail_en:
Energisation requires metering approval, electrical safety sign-off and commissioning witness.
- Western Power installs or approves metering under the Electricity Industry (Metering) Code 2012; installations must comply with the Technical Rules and WA Electrical Requirements.
- Building and Energy (Electrical Inspectors) must be satisfied before energisation.
- Western Power witnesses commissioning of transmission connection assets and may impose staged energisation and ramp constraints under the ETAC where system studies show voltage or stability limits.
- The Coordinator of Energy's 2026 reform work also considers minimum state-of-charge and storage obligations that could affect co-located BESS.
steps.detail_zh:
送电前须完成计量核准、电气安全签核及调试见证。
- Western Power依《2012年电力工业（计量）守则》安装或批准计量装置；安装须符合《技术规则》及西澳电气要求。
- 送电前须获Building and Energy（电气检查员）认可。
- Western Power见证输电接入资产调试，系统研究显示存在电压或稳定性限制时，可依ETAC施加分阶段送电及爬坡约束。
- 能源协调官2026年的改革工作也在考虑可能影响共址储能的最低荷电状态及储能义务。
steps.authority: Western Power; Building and Energy (DEMIRS); AEMO (system operator)
steps.legal_basis: Electricity Industry (Metering) Code 2012 (WA); Technical Rules; Electricity (Licensing) Regulations 1991
steps.typical_duration: Commissioning 2–6 months per stage
steps.overlap_note_en: Entirely WA-regulated; no NER/AEMO NEM commissioning procedures apply.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 完全由西澳监管；不适用NER/AEMO的NEM调试程序。

recent_changes.summary_en: WA joined National Cabinet's mandatory data centre standards (26 Aug 2026); implementation in the WEM will require separate WA legislation/rule changes, timing not yet announced.
recent_changes.summary_zh: Western Power完成大客户接入审查后，于2026年6月发布更新的《大客户接入程序》及季度《大客户接入洞察报告》，力图为大负荷及发电项目提供更简化路径。

recent_changes.summary_en: The Department of Energy and Economic Diversification released an issues paper (20 July) on DER data and connections reform, including larger DER systems and network capacity sharing; a 4 August consultation paper on Capability Class 2 electric storage resources proposed AEMO powers to set minimum state of charge.
recent_changes.summary_zh: 能源与经济多元化部7月20日发布DER数据及接入改革议题文件，涉及大型DER系统与网络容量共享；8月4日就二类储能资源咨询文件建议赋予AEMO设定最低荷电状态权限。

recent_changes.summary_en: Western Power published its updated Major Customer Connection Process and quarterly Major Customer Connections Insights Report following its major customer connection review, targeting a more streamlined pathway for large loads and generators.
recent_changes.summary_zh: 国家内阁2026年8月26日通过强制性数据中心标准，西澳已加入；在WEM落地尚待专门立法或规则修改，具体时间未定。

jurisdictions.key_bodies: State Planning Commission / State Commission Assessment Panel (SCAP), council assessment panels, Coordinator-General (Office for Major Projects), Department for Housing and Urban Development (PlanSA), SA EPA, Office of the Technical Regulator (OTR), SA Water, ElectraNet (TNSP), SA Power Networks (DNSP), Essential Services Commission of SA, AEMO, AER, AEMC
jurisdictions.overview_en:
South Australia is actively courting AI data centres on the strength of its roughly 75% renewable grid and A$32bn renewable pipeline.
- Planning approval runs under the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act 2016 and the Planning and Design Code; late-2025 changes routed data centres into an 'essential infrastructure' style pathway assessed by the State Planning Commission rather than councils.
- The June 2026 data centre strategy ('New energy for new demand') promises a dedicated Data Centre and AI Infrastructure Act with a Coordinator-General decision pathway, mandatory SA Water supply confirmation and Technical Regulator certification of power-system compliance; the legislation had not been introduced as of September 2026, so details remain provisional.
- Grid connection follows NER Chapter 5 with ElectraNet (New Customer Connection Guide, 30 March 2026, with explicit inverter-based-load and system-strength provisions) or NER Chapter 5A/5 with SA Power Networks (Manual 18, June 2026).
- SA's small, inverter-dominated system means system-strength and stability studies weigh heavily on large loads, and the IREN Bundey proposal has made water access a political issue.
jurisdictions.overview_zh:
南澳凭借约75%可再生能源占比的电网及320亿澳元可再生能源储备，积极招揽AI数据中心。
- 规划审批依《2016年规划、发展与基础设施法》及《规划与设计准则》办理；2025年底的调整已将数据中心导入由州规划委员会而非议会评估的“基础设施”类路径。
- 2026年6月发布的数据中心战略（“以新能源满足新需求”）承诺出台专门的《数据中心与AI基础设施法》，设立总协调官决策路径、强制SA Water供水确认及技术监管官对电力系统合规的认证；截至2026年9月立法尚未提交议会，细节仍属暂定。
- 电网接入依NER第5章与ElectraNet办理（2026年3月30日《新客户接入指南》，含明确的逆变器型负荷及系统强度条款），或依NER第5A/5章与SA Power Networks办理（2026年6月第18号手册）。
- 南澳系统规模小且以逆变器为主，系统强度及稳定性研究对大负荷影响显著，IREN在Bundey的提案已使用水问题成为政治议题。

steps.title_en: Site selection, Planning and Design Code zoning and Coordinator-General / Invest SA engagement
steps.title_zh: 选址、《规划与设计准则》分区及总协调官对接
steps.detail_en:
Siting rests on the Planning and Design Code's zone rules plus early Coordinator-General case management.
- Under the PDI Act, the Planning and Design Code sets zone-based rules; data centres fit as 'industry'/'data centre'-type uses within Strategic Employment, Employment and Infrastructure zones.
- Greenfield sites in the Mid North or Upper Spencer Gulf, near ElectraNet's 275 kV network and the proposed Northern Water desalination pipeline, are being actively promoted.
- The Coordinator-General's Office for Major Projects and the Department of State Development case-manage large investments; the June 2026 strategy requires future applications to include SA Water confirmation of sufficient water availability.
- Native title and Aboriginal Heritage Act 1988 clearances are handled at this stage.
steps.detail_zh:
选址取决于《规划与设计准则》的分区规则，并配合总协调官的早期个案管理。
- 依PDI法，《规划与设计准则》设定基于分区的规则；数据中心以“工业”/“数据中心”类用途落入战略就业、就业及基础设施区。
- 州政府正积极推广中北部或上斯宾塞湾的新开发场址，该区域靠近ElectraNet 275 kV网络及拟建的北部海水淡化输水管。
- 总协调官的重大项目办公室及州发展部对大型投资进行个案管理；2026年6月战略要求未来申请须附SA Water确认有充足供水。
- 原住民土地权及《1988年原住民遗产法》审批在此阶段办理。
steps.authority: PlanSA / State Planning Commission; Coordinator-General; Invest SA
steps.legal_basis: Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act 2016 (SA); Planning and Design Code (zone policies); Aboriginal Heritage Act 1988
steps.typical_duration: 2–6 months
steps.overlap_note_en: FIRB and Commonwealth expectations run in parallel; SA promotes itself as aligned with the federal renewable-backed model.
steps.overlap_note_zh: FIRB审查及联邦期望框架并行推进；南澳以契合联邦可再生能源支撑模式作为卖点。

steps.title_en: Development approval under the PDI Act: State Planning Commission 'essential infrastructure' pathway (and proposed Data Centre and AI Infrastructure Act)
steps.title_zh: 开发批准：州规划委员会"基础设施"路径
steps.detail_en:
Data centres are assessed on an essential-infrastructure track rather than through ordinary council processes.
- Since late 2025, the State Planning Commission (through SCAP), not a council assessment panel, has been the relevant authority for major data centre proposals.
- Applications are lodged on the PlanSA portal, assessed against the Code as performance-assessed development with public notification where required, and decided within the statutory 8–12 week period, extended where referred to the EPA, SA Water, ElectraNet/SAPN and the Technical Regulator.
- The June 2026 strategy proposes a Data Centre and AI Infrastructure Act giving the Coordinator-General decision power over major projects and reducing duplication; the Bill's text, thresholds and timing remained unpublished as of September 2026.
- Proposals with major environmental implications can instead be declared 'impact assessed development' under s 108, requiring an EIS and a Ministerial decision.
- At 7 October 2026 the Data Centre and AI Infrastructure Bill had still not been introduced, and the AI Royal Commission terms of reference signed on 1 October 2026 expressly exclude data centre matters, leaving the PDI Act essential infrastructure pathway as the only operative route.
steps.detail_zh:
数据中心走基础设施类评估路径，而非常规议会审批程序。
- 自2025年底起，州规划委员会（通过SCAP）而非议会评估委员会成为重大数据中心提案的相关审批机构。
- 申请在PlanSA门户提交，作为绩效评估开发依准则评估，准则要求时须公告，并在法定8–12周内决定，转介EPA、SA Water、ElectraNet/SAPN及技术监管官时延长。
- 2026年6月战略拟出台《数据中心与AI基础设施法》，赋予总协调官对重大项目的决定权并减少重复审批；截至2026年9月法案文本、门槛及时间表仍未公布。
- 具有重大环境影响的提案可依第108条改为宣布“影响评估开发”，须编制EIS并由部长决定。
- 截至2026年10月7日，Data Centre and AI Infrastructure Bill仍未提交州议会；2026年10月1日签署的AI Royal Commission职权范围明确排除数据中心事项，PDI Act基础设施路径仍是唯一可用途径。
steps.authority: State Planning Commission / State Commission Assessment Panel; Minister for Planning (impact assessed); proposed Coordinator-General role
steps.legal_basis: Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act 2016 (SA) ss 102–110 (assessment pathways), s 108 (impact assessed development); Planning and Design Code; proposed Data Centre and AI Infrastructure Act (announced 23–24 June 2026, not yet introduced)
steps.typical_duration: 3–9 months for performance-assessed; 12–24 months if impact assessed
steps.overlap_note_en: EPBC referral, if triggered, is coordinated under the SA bilateral agreement; National Cabinet standards will overlay once legislated, with SA presenting its Act as the state implementation vehicle.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 如触发EPBC评估，依南澳双边协议协调办理；国家内阁标准立法后将叠加，南澳拟将其法案定位为州级落实载体。

steps.title_en: Environmental licensing (EPA), water supply confirmation (SA Water) and Technical Regulator certification
steps.title_zh: 环境许可、供水确认及技术监管官认证
steps.detail_en:
Environmental, water and technical-compliance sign-offs run alongside planning.
- Backup generation above the Schedule 1 thresholds of the Environment Protection Act 1993 (fuel-burning/electricity generation activities) requires an EPA licence; the EPA is a mandatory referral body for noise and air.
- The June 2026 strategy requires SA Water confirmation of available supply as part of the application, a point made politically salient by the IREN Bundey proposal.
- It also requires 'certification from the Technical Regulator that projects comply with the requirements of the state's power system', an SA-specific step under the Electricity Act 1996 with no NEM equivalent.
- Electrical installations additionally need OTR certificates of compliance before energisation.
steps.detail_zh:
环境、供水及技术合规签核与规划审批同步进行。
- 超过《1993年环境保护法》附表1门槛的备用发电（燃烧/发电活动）需EPA许可；EPA是噪声及空气方面的强制转介机构。
- 2026年6月战略要求申请中须附SA Water供水确认，该要求因IREN Bundey提案而具有政治敏感性。
- 战略还要求“技术监管官出具项目符合本州电力系统要求的认证”，这是依《1996年电力法》设立的南澳特有步骤，NEM中无对应程序。
- 电气装置在送电前还须取得OTR合规证书。
steps.authority: SA EPA; SA Water; Office of the Technical Regulator
steps.legal_basis: Environment Protection Act 1993 (SA) Sch 1 and Part 6; Electricity Act 1996 (SA) Part 4 (technical regulation) and s 60 (installation compliance); SA data centre strategy (June 2026)
steps.typical_duration: 3–6 months, concurrent with development assessment
steps.overlap_note_en: The Technical Regulator certification sits alongside, not instead of, AEMO/ElectraNet performance-standard approval under the NER.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 技术监管官认证与NER下AEMO/ElectraNet的性能标准审批并行，而非替代。

steps.title_en: ElectraNet transmission connection: pre-feasibility, enquiry and application (New Customer Connection Guide, March 2026)
steps.title_zh: ElectraNet输电接入：咨询与申请
steps.detail_en:
ElectraNet's Getting Connected guide sets a six-stage transmission connection process with explicit system-strength rules.
- The guide (v1, 30 March 2026) covers pre-feasibility/enquiry (cl 5.3.2, with a template response), application to connect (cl 5.3.4, using a dedicated 'Application to Connect Loads' form), offer to connect (cl 5.3.5), connection agreement execution, design/build/registration and compliance testing.
- Loads must propose Customer performance standards under Schedule 5.3 (S5.3.5, S5.3.11 are AEMO advisory matters).
- Inverter-based loads must supply PSS/E and PSCAD models with DMAT results and undergo a system strength impact assessment under cl 5.3.4B, choosing between self-remediation or a system strength charge (SSC = SSUP × SSL × SSQ).
- Stability assessments take about 6 to 12 weeks ('start when ready').
- ElectraNet's Assessment of Network Capacity for Connections report (June 2025) sets out available 275/132 kV headroom by region.
steps.detail_zh:
ElectraNet《接入指南》设定含明确系统强度规则的六阶段输电接入流程。
- 指南（v1，2026年3月30日）涵盖预可行性/咨询（第5.3.2条，附回复模板）、接入申请（第5.3.4条，使用专门的“负荷接入申请”表格）、接入报价（第5.3.5条）、接入协议签署、设计/建设/注册及合规测试。
- 负荷须依附表5.3提出客户性能标准（S5.3.5、S5.3.11为AEMO咨询事项）。
- 逆变器型负荷须提供PSS/E和PSCAD模型及DMAT结果，并依第5.3.4B条接受系统强度影响评估，可选择自行整治或支付系统强度费（SSC = SSUP × SSL × SSQ）。
- 稳定性评估约需6至12周（“就绪即启动”）。
- ElectraNet《接入网络容量评估报告》（2025年6月）按区域列出275/132 kV可用裕度。
steps.authority: ElectraNet (TNSP); AEMO (advisory matters, system strength)
steps.legal_basis: NER cl 5.3.2, 5.3.4, 5.3.4A, 5.3.4B, 5.3.5; Schedule 5.3 (S5.3.5, S5.3.11); ElectraNet Getting Connected guide (Mar 2026)
steps.typical_duration: Enquiry 30–40 business days; application to offer 9–15 months
steps.overlap_note_en: Pure NER Chapter 5 process; the ERC0394 large-IBL standards will apply to ≥30 MW data centres from the final rule's commencement.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 纯NER第5章程序；ERC0394大型逆变器型负荷标准将自最终规则生效起适用于30 MW及以上数据中心。

steps.title_en: SA Power Networks distribution connection (Manual 18: Connections & Ancillary Network Services, June 2026)
steps.title_zh: SA Power Networks配电接入（第18号手册）
steps.detail_en:
Smaller loads connect to SA Power Networks under NER Chapter 5A, with Manual 18 setting the local process.
- Loads up to roughly 30–60 MW connect at 11/33/66 kV under NER Chapter 5A Part D (negotiated connection, offer within 65 business days of a complete application), or Chapter 5 for the largest sites.
- SAPN's Manual 18 (issued June 2026) sets out enquiry, application, offer and ancillary service fees.
- SAPN's AER-approved Connection Policy governs capital contributions for connection assets and for augmentation beyond the planning horizon.
- SAPN operates the Essential Services Commission's Electricity Distribution Code and is a referral body for planning applications affecting its network.
steps.detail_zh:
较小负荷依NER第5A章接入SA Power Networks，第18号手册规定本地流程。
- 约30–60 MW以下负荷依NER第5A章D部分（协商接入，完整申请后65个工作日内报价）以11/33/66 kV接入，最大型场址则走第5章。
- SAPN第18号手册（2026年6月发布）规定了咨询、申请、报价及辅助服务费用。
- SAPN经AER批准的《接入政策》规范接入资产及规划期以外扩建的资本分摊。
- SAPN执行基本服务委员会的《配电守则》，并是影响其网络的规划申请的转介机构。
steps.authority: SA Power Networks (DNSP); AER; ESCOSA
steps.legal_basis: NER Chapter 5A Part D and Part E; SAPN Connection Policy (AER 2025–30 determination); SAPN Manual 18 (June 2026); Electricity Distribution Code (ESCOSA)
steps.typical_duration: Offer 65 business days; total 9–15 months
steps.overlap_note_en: Pure NER process with no SA-specific overlay to date.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 纯NER程序，目前无南澳特有的叠加规则。

steps.title_en: Offer, connection agreement, augmentation and cost allocation
steps.title_zh: 接入报价、协议、扩建与成本分担
steps.detail_en:
Cost allocation follows NER offer/agreement mechanics, with system strength charges an SA-specific add-on.
- The offer to connect (cl 5.3.6) and Transmission Connection Agreement (cl 5.3.7) allocate connection assets and dedicated connection assets to the applicant as negotiated transmission services.
- Shared augmentation (e.g. new 275 kV capacity in the Mid North tied to the Northern Transmission Project, or Project EnergyConnect headroom) is subject to the RIT-T (cl 5.16) and regulated recovery, unless pending Commonwealth cost-recovery rules assign it to the load instead.
- System strength charges under cl 5.3.4B are an additional SA-specific cost.
- The State strategy stresses that data centres 'must secure their own power supply' under a user-pays system with no subsidies.
steps.detail_zh:
成本分担依NER报价/协议机制办理，系统强度费是南澳特有附加成本。
- 接入报价（第5.3.6条）及输电接入协议（第5.3.7条）将接入资产和专用接入资产作为协商输电服务分配给申请人。
- 共享扩建（如与北部输电项目相关的中北部新275 kV容量，或EnergyConnect项目裕度）须经RIT-T（第5.16条）并由受监管收入回收，除非待审的联邦成本回收规则改为将其分配给负荷。
- 第5.3.4B条下的系统强度费是南澳特有的额外成本。
- 州战略强调数据中心“须自行确保电力供应”，采用用户付费、不设补贴的制度。
steps.authority: ElectraNet / SAPN; AER
steps.legal_basis: NER cl 5.3.6–5.3.7, 5.16 RIT-T, 5.3.4B system strength; Chapter 6A Part D
steps.typical_duration: 6–12 months to executed agreements
steps.overlap_note_en: National cost-allocation rules apply; SA has not proposed NSW-style state bonds or fees.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 适用全国成本分担规则；南澳未提议新州式的州级保证金或费用。

steps.title_en: Retailer/FRMP, AEMO registration, metering and renewable sourcing
steps.title_zh: 零售商/FRMP、AEMO注册与可再生采购
steps.detail_en:
Retail and registration follow the standard national process, with SA framing its renewable grid as a compliance advantage.
- A retailer licensed by ESCOSA is appointed as FRMP, or the operator registers with AEMO directly as a Market Customer; metering follows NER Chapter 7.
- SA's pitch is that its renewable-heavy grid makes compliance with the coming REGO/new-firm-capacity national standard straightforward.
- SA has not yet published binding PPA metrics like NSW's.
- Large flexible loads may also be attractive to AEMO for SA's system security needs; wholesale demand response or scheduled-load classification is optional today.
steps.detail_zh:
零售与注册遵循全国标准程序，南澳将其可再生电网作为合规优势。
- 由持有ESCOSA牌照的零售商担任FRMP，或运营商直接向AEMO注册为市场客户；计量遵循NER第7章。
- 南澳的卖点是其高比例可再生电网使遵守即将出台的REGO/新增可靠容量全国标准较为容易。
- 南澳尚未像新州那样公布约束性PPA指标。
- 大型灵活负荷对AEMO应对南澳系统安全需求也具吸引力；目前参与批发需求响应或可调度负荷分类为自愿。
steps.authority: Retailer/FRMP; AEMO; ESCOSA
steps.legal_basis: NER Chapter 2 and 7; Electricity Act 1996 (SA) retail licensing
steps.typical_duration: 3–9 months
steps.overlap_note_en: National process; SA adds no state requirement beyond retail licensing.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 全国程序；除零售牌照外南澳未增加州级要求。

steps.title_en: Construction, R2/compliance testing, OTR sign-off and energisation
steps.title_zh: 建设、合规测试、OTR签核与送电
steps.detail_en:
Final steps combine building consent, R2-style testing and technical sign-off before full capacity is released.
- Building consent is granted under the PDI Act by a council or private certifier.
- ElectraNet's guide requires compliance and on-system testing (Schedule 5.5.2(b)-style R2 testing), with AEMO-endorsed test plans for large inverter-based loads, before full release of capacity.
- OTR certificates of compliance are required for the installation.
- Energisation is normally staged, with model validation carried out after each stage.
steps.detail_zh:
投运前的收尾环节包括建筑许可、R2式测试及技术签核，全部容量分阶段释放。
- 建筑许可依PDI法由议会或私人审核员发放。
- ElectraNet指南要求大型逆变器型负荷在全部容量释放前完成合规及在网测试（类似附表5.5.2(b)的R2测试），测试方案须经AEMO认可。
- 装置须取得OTR合规证书。
- 送电通常分阶段进行，每阶段后进行模型验证。
steps.authority: ElectraNet / SAPN; AEMO; Office of the Technical Regulator; building certifier
steps.legal_basis: NER cl 5.7–5.8, Schedule 5.5; PDI Act 2016 Part 7 Div 1 (building consent); Electricity Act 1996 (SA) s 60
steps.typical_duration: Commissioning 2–6 months per stage
steps.overlap_note_en: NER/AEMO testing is national; OTR certification is the SA-specific addition.
steps.overlap_note_zh: NER/AEMO测试属全国程序；OTR认证是南澳特有的附加环节。

recent_changes.summary_en: The terms of reference for South Australia's AI Royal Commission were signed by the Governor on 1 October 2026 and expressly exclude data centre matters, while the Data Centre and AI Infrastructure Bill announced on 23 June 2026 remains unintroduced.
recent_changes.summary_zh: 南澳AI Royal Commission的职权范围于2026年10月1日由总督签署，明确将数据中心事项排除在外；2026年6月23日宣布的Data Centre and AI Infrastructure Bill仍未提交州议会。

recent_changes.summary_en: SA signed on to National Cabinet's mandatory data centre standards (26 Aug 2026) and positions its renewable grid as the compliance advantage.
recent_changes.summary_zh: 据Ashurst总结，2025年底的规划调整已将数据中心导入PDI法下的基础设施类评估路径（由州规划委员会作为相关审批机构），具体准则修正案编号有待在PlanSA核实。

recent_changes.summary_en: Premier Malinauskas launched the SA data centre strategy (23–24 June 2026) promising a Data Centre and AI Infrastructure Act, Coordinator-General decision pathway, SA Water supply confirmation and Technical Regulator certification; SAPN issued Manual 18 (Connections & Ancillary Network Services).
recent_changes.summary_zh: 州长Malinauskas于2026年6月23–24日发布南澳数据中心战略，承诺出台《数据中心与AI基础设施法》、设立总协调官决策路径、SA Water供水确认及技术监管官认证；SAPN同期发布第18号手册（接入与辅助网络服务）。

recent_changes.summary_en: ElectraNet issued its Getting Connected guide (5 and 30 March 2026 versions) with a dedicated load application form, IBL model requirements and system strength charge methodology.
recent_changes.summary_zh: 南澳于2026年8月26日加入国家内阁强制性数据中心标准，并将其可再生电网定位为合规优势。

recent_changes.summary_en: Late-2025 planning changes moved data centres into an essential-infrastructure style assessment pathway under the PDI Act (State Planning Commission as relevant authority), per Ashurst's summary; the exact Code amendment reference should be confirmed on PlanSA.
recent_changes.summary_zh: ElectraNet于2026年3月发布《接入指南》（5日及30日两版），新增专门的负荷申请表、逆变器型负荷模型要求及系统强度费计算方法。

jurisdictions.market: NEM (Tasmanian region, connected via Basslink; Marinus Link under construction)
jurisdictions.key_bodies: Local planning authorities (councils) and Tasmanian Planning Commission, Minister for Planning (Major Projects), Office of the Coordinator-General, EPA Tasmania (EMPCA), TasNetworks (combined TNSP and DNSP), Hydro Tasmania, Office of the Tasmanian Economic Regulator, TasWater, AEMO, AER, AEMC
jurisdictions.overview_en:
Tasmania markets 100% renewable supply, cool climate and low disaster risk to data centre and AI-compute proponents.
- The Coordinator-General's pipeline, revealed 9 September 2026, holds six confidential proposals totalling up to 705 MW, on top of Firmus Technologies' 444 MW public Southgate program.
- Planning consent is a council permit under the Land Use Planning and Approvals Act 1993 and the Tasmanian Planning Scheme, or, for large or multi-council projects, the Major Projects pathway (LUPAA Division 2A), where the Minister declares the project and an independent Development Assessment Panel decides.
- Environmental assessment of Level 2 activities sits with EPA Tasmania under EMPCA 1994.
- TasNetworks is both TNSP and DNSP, so a single NER Chapter 5 process applies to transmission loads, and it requires land, planning approvals, supplier selection, Board approvals and financial close before treating a load as committed.
- On 7 September 2026 the Government released Draft Expectations for Data Centres and AI Infrastructure Developers (consultation to 12 October 2026), requiring proponents to support additional renewable generation, meet their share of network/connection costs and protect grid security; the policy is non-binding for now, and critics want it given statutory force.
jurisdictions.overview_zh:
塔州以100%可再生供电、凉爽气候及低灾害风险向数据中心及AI算力业主推介。
- 总协调官项目储备（2026年9月9日曝光）包含六个保密提案，合计最多705 MW，另有Firmus Technologies公开的444 MW Southgate计划。
- 规划许可依《1993年土地利用规划与审批法》及《塔州规划方案》以议会许可形式发放，或对大型或跨议会项目走重大项目路径（LUPAA第2A分部），由部长宣布项目并由独立开发评估委员会裁定。
- 二级活动的环境评估依《1994年环境管理与污染控制法》由塔州EPA负责。
- TasNetworks兼为TNSP和DNSP，输电负荷因此适用单一的NER第5章程序；TasNetworks要求在土地、规划批准、供应商选择、董事会批准及融资关闭完成后，才将负荷视为已承诺。
- 2026年9月7日州政府发布《数据中心与AI基础设施开发商期望草案》（咨询至10月12日），要求业主支持新增可再生发电、承担应分摊的网络/接入成本并保护电网安全；该政策目前不具约束力，批评者呼吁赋予法定效力。

steps.title_en: Site selection, Coordinator-General engagement and Draft Expectations alignment
steps.title_zh: 选址、总协调官对接及与期望草案对齐
steps.detail_en:
Proponents typically engage the Coordinator-General first, then align with the Draft Expectations and confirm zoning.
- The Office of the Coordinator-General case-manages investment and holds a confidential pipeline; the Examiner reports many proponents had not yet engaged TasNetworks or generators, which the Government now expects to happen early.
- The Draft Expectations (7 September 2026) ask proponents to support additional renewable generation, pay their share of network and connection costs, use water responsibly, engage communities, and follow standard approvals with no automatic approvals.
- Zoning under the Tasmanian Planning Scheme (General or Light Industrial, or Utilities zone) is checked at this stage.
- The 2018 Data Centre Action Strategy remains the only sector strategy document.
- Consultation on the Draft Expectations closes 12 October 2026, feedback is analysed during October and the final Expectations are to be released by end-2026.
steps.detail_zh:
业主通常先接触总协调官，再对齐期望草案要求并核查分区。
- 总协调官办公室对投资进行个案管理并持有保密项目储备；据《审查者报》报道，许多业主尚未接触TasNetworks或发电商，州政府现期望其尽早接洽。
- 《期望草案》（2026年9月7日）要求业主支持新增可再生发电、支付其应分摊的网络及接入成本、负责任用水、与社区沟通，并遵循标准审批、不设自动批准。
- 此阶段核查《塔州规划方案》分区（一般或轻工业区，或公用设施区）。
- 2018年《数据中心行动战略》仍是唯一的行业战略文件。
- 《期望草案》意见征集于2026年10月12日截止，10月内完成反馈分析，最终版预计2026年底发布。
steps.authority: Office of the Coordinator-General; Department of State Growth; local planning authority
steps.legal_basis: Land Use Planning and Approvals Act 1993 (Tas); Tasmanian Planning Scheme (State Planning Provisions zones); Draft Expectations for Data Centres and AI Infrastructure Developers (Sept 2026, non-statutory)
steps.typical_duration: 2–6 months
steps.overlap_note_en: The Tasmanian Expectations mirror the Commonwealth's March 2026 expectations and National Cabinet standards; FIRB applies to foreign proponents.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 塔州期望框架与联邦2026年3月期望及国家内阁标准相呼应；FIRB适用于外国业主。

steps.title_en: Planning permit under LUPAA: council pathway or Major Projects declaration
steps.title_zh: LUPAA规划许可：议会路径或重大项目宣布
steps.detail_en:
Approval runs through either a council permit or the state Major Projects declaration.
- A discretionary permit application is lodged with the council under s 57 of LUPAA (42-day statutory decision period after validity, extendable), with public advertising and appeal rights to the Tasmanian Civil and Administrative Tribunal.
- For projects of state significance or spanning several municipalities, the proponent can ask the Minister for Planning to declare a 'major project' under LUPAA Part 4 Division 2A.
- The Tasmanian Planning Commission then convenes a Development Assessment Panel that issues assessment criteria, coordinates EPA, TasWater and heritage approvals, and decides within about 12–18 months, with no merits appeal.
- Council-level concern over energy and water is rising following the September 2026 disclosures.
steps.detail_zh:
审批走议会许可路径或州级重大项目宣布路径。
- 依LUPAA第57条向议会提交酌情许可申请（有效后42天法定决定期，可延长），须公告并可向塔州民事与行政法庭上诉。
- 对于具有州级重要性或跨多个市政区的项目，业主可申请规划部长依LUPAA第4部分第2A分部宣布为“重大项目”。
- 此后塔州规划委员会组建开发评估委员会，发布评估标准，协调EPA、TasWater及遗产审批，并在约12–18个月内决定，无实体上诉。
- 2026年9月信息披露后，议会层面对能源及用水的关注正在上升。
steps.authority: Local planning authority (council) / TASCAT; Minister for Planning and Tasmanian Planning Commission DAP (Major Projects)
steps.legal_basis: Land Use Planning and Approvals Act 1993 (Tas) s 57 (discretionary permits), Part 4 Division 2A (Major Projects, inserted 2020)
steps.typical_duration: Council 3–9 months incl. appeals; Major Project 12–18 months
steps.overlap_note_en: EPBC matters can be assessed through the Tasmanian bilateral agreement; National Cabinet standards will overlay once legislated.
steps.overlap_note_zh: EPBC事项可通过塔州双边协议评估；国家内阁标准立法后将叠加。

steps.title_en: Environmental assessment by EPA Tasmania (EMPCA Level 2 activities)
steps.title_zh: 塔州EPA环境评估（EMPCA二级活动）
steps.detail_en:
Level 2 activities trigger a mandatory EPA referral alongside the planning permit.
- Where a project includes a Level 2 activity under Schedule 2 of EMPCA 1994 (e.g. fuel-burning/electricity generation above the threshold, or large fuel storage), the council must refer the permit application to the EPA Board.
- The EPA Board assesses the referral, often requiring an Environmental Effects Report or EIS, and issues environmental conditions binding on the permit.
- TasWater servicing and Hydro Tasmania water-licence issues arise where cooling-water demand is significant.
steps.detail_zh:
二级活动触发向EPA的强制转介，与规划许可同步办理。
- 项目若含《1994年环境管理与污染控制法》附表2列明的二级活动（如超过门槛的燃烧/发电或大型燃油储存），议会须将许可申请转交EPA董事会。
- EPA董事会评估该转介（通常要求编制环境影响报告或EIS），并发布对许可具有约束力的环境条件。
- 冷却用水量大时还涉及TasWater服务及Hydro Tasmania水许可问题。
steps.authority: EPA Tasmania (Board of the EPA)
steps.legal_basis: Environmental Management and Pollution Control Act 1994 (Tas) s 25, Sch 2 (Level 2 activities)
steps.typical_duration: 4–12 months, integrated with permit
steps.overlap_note_en: No Commonwealth equivalent unless EPBC triggered.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 除触发EPBC外无联邦对应程序。

steps.title_en: TasNetworks transmission load connection: enquiry, application and 'committed' criteria
steps.title_zh: TasNetworks输电接入及"已承诺"标准
steps.detail_en:
TasNetworks runs a standard NER Chapter 5 process but applies its own strict 'committed project' test.
- TasNetworks follows the NER Chapter 5 process (enquiry cl 5.3.2–5.3.3, application cl 5.3.4, offer cl 5.3.6), using its Transmission customer connection enquiry form and Guide to Applying for a Transmission Connection.
- Because the NER does not define when a load is 'committed', TasNetworks only treats a project as committed once it has firm land rights, a complete connection application, selected major plant suppliers, all planning consents, progressed performance standards, Board approvals from both sides with an executed Asset Development Agreement and Customer Connection Agreement, and written confirmation of financial close.
- Available 110/220 kV capacity is concentrated in the north (George Town/Bell Bay) and around Hobart; Marinus Link and the North West Transmission Developments will change headroom from 2028–30.
steps.detail_zh:
TasNetworks遵循标准的NER第5章程序，但自设了严格的“已承诺项目”标准。
- TasNetworks遵循NER第5章接入程序（咨询第5.3.2–5.3.3条、申请第5.3.4条、报价第5.3.6条），使用其输电客户接入咨询表及《输电接入申请指南》。
- 由于NER未定义负荷何时“已承诺”，TasNetworks仅在项目具备确定土地权利、完整接入申请、已选定主要设备供应商、取得全部规划许可、性能标准已推进、双方董事会批准并签署资产开发协议和客户接入协议、以及融资关闭书面确认后，才视为已承诺。
- 可用110/220 kV容量集中在北部（George Town/Bell Bay）及霍巴特周边；Marinus Link和西北输电开发项目将在2028–30年改变裕度。
steps.authority: TasNetworks (TNSP); AEMO (advisory matters)
steps.legal_basis: NER cl 5.3.2–5.3.7, Schedule 5.3; Electricity Supply Industry Act 1995 (Tas) network licence conditions; TasNetworks Transmission Load Connections Process
steps.typical_duration: Enquiry 30–40 business days; 18–30 months enquiry to energisation
steps.overlap_note_en: Pure NER process; TasNetworks' committed-project criteria are contractual policy and echo Transgrid's readiness tests.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 纯NER程序；TasNetworks的已承诺项目标准属合同政策，与Transgrid的准备度测试类似。

steps.title_en: Distribution connection (TasNetworks as DNSP) for smaller loads
steps.title_zh: 配电接入（TasNetworks作DNSP）
steps.detail_en:
Smaller loads connect under NER Chapter 5A, with TasNetworks' dual TNSP/DNSP role easing any later upgrade.
- Loads below roughly 20–30 MW connect at 11/22/33 kV under NER Chapter 5A Part D (negotiated connection, offer within 65 business days of a complete application), with capital contributions under TasNetworks' AER-approved connection policy.
- TasNetworks' connections hub routes customers by connection type.
- Because the same organisation handles transmission, an upgrade from distribution to transmission connection as a campus grows is coordinated internally.
steps.detail_zh:
较小负荷依NER第5A章接入，TasNetworks兼任TNSP/DNSP便于后续升级。
- 约20–30 MW以下负荷依NER第5A章D部分（协商接入，完整申请后65个工作日内报价）以11/22/33 kV接入，并按TasNetworks经AER批准的接入政策缴纳资本分摊。
- TasNetworks接入中心按接入类型对客户分流。
- 由于同一机构负责输电，园区扩张时从配电升级为输电接入可在内部协调完成。
steps.authority: TasNetworks (DNSP); AER
steps.legal_basis: NER Chapter 5A Parts D–E; TasNetworks Connection Policy (AER 2024–29)
steps.typical_duration: Offer 65 business days; 6–12 months total
steps.overlap_note_en: Pure NER process.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 纯NER程序。

steps.title_en: Connection agreements, augmentation and cost sharing; renewable generation support expectation
steps.title_zh: 接入协议、扩建与成本分担
steps.detail_en:
Cost sharing follows NER mechanics, but Tasmania's small customer base makes socialised augmentation costs politically sensitive.
- Connection assets are funded by the customer under the Customer Connection Agreement/Asset Development Agreement.
- Shared augmentation is subject to the RIT-T (cl 5.16) and regulated recovery, which is politically sensitive given Tasmania's small customer base.
- The Draft Expectations accordingly require proponents to 'meet their share of network and connection costs' and 'support additional renewable energy generation'; reported Government policy also requires major data centre loads to be matched by new renewable generation to protect grid security.
- Hydro Tasmania's contracting capacity and Marinus Link timing constrain how much firm renewable supply can be offered.
steps.detail_zh:
成本分担遵循NER机制，但塔州用户基数小，使增容成本社会化分摊在政治上较为敏感。
- 接入资产由客户依客户接入协议/资产开发协议出资。
- 共享扩建须经RIT-T（第5.16条）并由受监管收入回收，鉴于塔州用户基数小，这在政治上较为敏感。
- 《期望草案》因此要求业主“承担其应分摊的网络及接入成本”并“支持新增可再生发电”；据报道州政府政策还要求重大数据中心负荷须配套新建可再生发电以保护电网安全。
- Hydro Tasmania的合约供应能力及Marinus Link时间表限制了可提供的可靠可再生电力规模。
steps.authority: TasNetworks; AER; Tasmanian Government (Expectations)
steps.legal_basis: NER cl 5.3.7, 5.16 RIT-T, Chapter 6A Part D; Draft Expectations (Sept 2026)
steps.typical_duration: 6–12 months to executed agreements
steps.overlap_note_en: National cost-allocation rules apply; Tasmania's Expectations anticipate the Commonwealth 'pay full network costs' and 'underwrite new supply' standards.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 适用全国成本分担规则；塔州期望框架预先呼应了联邦“全额支付网络成本”及“承保新增供电”标准。

steps.title_en: Retailer/FRMP, AEMO registration, metering, commissioning and energisation
steps.title_zh: 零售商/FRMP、注册、调试与送电
steps.detail_en:
Retail contracting, registration, metering and commissioning follow the standard national process.
- Supply is contracted from Aurora Energy or a contestable retailer (customers above 150 MWh/yr are contestable, with the Tasmanian Economic Regulator overseeing retail), or the operator registers as a Market Customer.
- Metering follows NER Chapter 7.
- TasNetworks witnesses commissioning under NER cl 5.7–5.8, and electrical installations require certificates under the Occupational Licensing Act 2005.
- Staged energisation aligned with generation contracting is expected given the Government's new-generation policy.
steps.detail_zh:
零售合约、注册、计量与调试遵循全国标准程序。
- 电力从Aurora Energy或可竞争零售商购买（年用电量超过150 MWh的客户可自由选择，塔州经济监管官监督零售），或运营商注册为市场客户。
- 计量遵循NER第7章。
- TasNetworks依NER第5.7–5.8条见证调试，电气装置须依《2005年职业许可法》取得证书。
- 鉴于州政府的新建电源政策，预计送电将与发电合约进度分阶段匹配。
steps.authority: Retailer/FRMP; AEMO; TasNetworks; Office of the Tasmanian Economic Regulator
steps.legal_basis: NER Chapters 2, 5 (cl 5.7–5.8) and 7; Electricity Supply Industry Act 1995 (Tas); Occupational Licensing Act 2005 (Tas)
steps.typical_duration: 3–9 months retail; commissioning 2–6 months per stage
steps.overlap_note_en: National process; Tasmania adds electrical licensing sign-off only.
steps.overlap_note_zh: 全国程序；塔州仅增加电气许可签核。

recent_changes.summary_en: Tasmanian Government released Draft Expectations for Data Centres and AI Infrastructure Developers (7 Sept 2026; consultation to 12 Oct 2026): support additional renewable generation, meet share of network/connection costs, protect grid security, use water responsibly, no automatic approvals.
recent_changes.summary_zh: 塔州政府于2026年9月7日发布《数据中心与AI基础设施开发商期望草案》（咨询至10月12日）：要求支持新增可再生发电、承担应分摊的网络/接入成本、保护电网安全、负责任用水，且不设自动批准。

recent_changes.summary_en: A Coordinator-General document revealed six confidential data centre proposals totalling up to 705 MW (including two 200–300 MW AI projects) alongside Firmus' 444 MW Southgate program; many proponents had not yet engaged TasNetworks.
recent_changes.summary_zh: 总协调官文件披露六个保密数据中心提案，合计最多705 MW（含两个200–300 MW的AI项目），另有Firmus公开的444 MW Southgate计划；据报道许多业主尚未接触TasNetworks。
